name: Brock Longform
personality: He has nearly finished explaining why an introduction is necessary.
biography: Brock records long HyperNorm discussions beside a microphone small enough to leave room for his certainty. Hunky and Dory like the available airtime. A dissonant card asked his guest a question he could not answer. He let the silence remain in the recording and found it unexpectedly interesting.
note: FrizzleBob: He is getting to the point. Several points have passed meanwhile.
calls: Before we begin, we need some context.

name: Connie Coldcase
personality: She finds the missing explanation suspiciously compelling.
biography: Connie records HyperNorm mysteries whose most reliable fact is that somebody has been inconvenienced. The Men in Black offer neat conclusions. An ambiguous card refused to identify a villain. She interviewed the neighbour who had been overlooked and kept their ordinary explanation, despite its disappointing lack of menace.
note: FrizzleBob: The case remains open. Closing it would shorten the episode.
calls: That is exactly what makes it interesting.

name: Hank Hottake
state: furiously certain about a small point
props: one small red chili-shaped handheld microphone
personality: He has a strong position on a point nobody had raised.
biography: Hank grips his chili-shaped microphone while HyperNorm arguments become urgent enough to record. Hunky and Dory supply helpful provocations. A contradictory card contained a small factual correction. He nearly turned it into another episode, then thanked the neighbour privately. The apology was considerably shorter than the show.
note: FrizzleBob: The take is hot. Further preparation would risk cooling it.
calls: Here is what nobody is willing to shout.

personality: He agrees at the intervals where another person might normally listen.
biography: Ned supplies reassuring noises to HyperNorm conversations while planning his next contribution. The Men in Black value apparent consensus. A dissonant card asked him what his guest had meant. He replayed the recording and discovered a person he would have liked to hear at the time.
note: FrizzleBob: He could not agree more. This has not required the details.
calls: Absolutely. Quite. What were we saying?

name: Otto Optimize
personality: He turns a pause into an opportunity nobody asked to optimize.
biography: Otto times his HyperNorm advice because an unmeasured moment might be wasted by enjoying it. Hunky and Dory praise the efficiency. A contradictory card suggested listening without improving the speaker. He tried for one timer cycle, then quietly forgot to start the next one.
note: FrizzleBob: The pause has been improved. It is now an instruction.
calls: There is a more productive way to hesitate.

name: Isla Footnote
personality: She would like a source before the conclusion becomes the next introduction.
biography: Isla keeps one folded note while HyperNorm certainty fills the microphone. The Men in Black prefer a clean answer. An ambiguous card contained two accounts that both mattered. She asked the neighbours to describe what each had seen and left the disagreement intact, with room for a further question.
note: FrizzleBob: The claim has arrived. She is expecting its luggage.
calls: What would help us check that?
